basic_details.job_title: NFDC Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 15 Assistant, Senior Excecutive and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: National Film Development Corporation Ltd. (NFDC), a Government of India Enterprise, has invited applications for 15 posts on contract basis for Waves Film Bazaar to be held at Mumbai, vide Advertisement No. 63/Contractual/23.07.2026. The available positions include Senior Programmer, Junior Programmer, Jr. Co-Ordinator, Editor, Executive, and Sr. Executive roles across departments such as Co-Production Market, WIP Lab, Knowledge Series, Registration, Guest Relations, and Hospitality & Logistics. Eligible candidates are Graduates or Post Graduates in Mass Communication, Film Studies, Humanitie

qualification.details: Candidates applying for NFDC Waves Film Bazaar 2026 posts must hold a Graduate or Post Graduate degree in Mass Communication, Film Studies, Humanities, Arts and Literature, or a related discipline, depending on the specific post. Required experience ranges from 4 years for Junior/Assistant level posts to 8 years for Senior level posts. Desirable qualifications include prior work experience in international film festivals, film production houses, or hospitality-related certifications such as IATA for the Guest Relations post. Age limit varies from 35 to 45 years across posts, with relaxation permitted at the discretion of NFDC management for deserving candidates.

salary_details.details: The remuneration for NFDC Waves Film Bazaar contractual posts ranges from Rs. 40,000 per month for Assistant and Editor level posts to Rs. 70,000 per month for Senior Programmer level posts. Mid-level Sr. Executive and Registration posts carry a salary of Rs. 65,000 per month, while Junior Programmer and Executive posts are fixed at Rs. 55,000 per month.

how_to_apply: Eligible candidates must fill up the application form through the NFDC LinkedIn Portal on or before 3rd August 2026, till 6:00 PM. No other mode of application is specified. Candidates are advised to keep their registered e-mail ID active for at least one year, as no change of e-mail ID will be permitted once submitted, and all future correspondence will be sent via e-mail or to the permanent address mentioned in the application form.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies has NFDC announced for Waves Film Bazaar 2026?
faq.answer: NFDC has announced a total of 15 vacancies on contract basis for various posts at Waves Film Bazaar, Mumbai.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NFDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online through the NFDC LinkedIn Portal is 3rd August 2026, till 6:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered under NFDC Waves Film Bazaar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 40,000 to Rs. 70,000 per month depending on the post applied for.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for NFDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online by filling the application form on the NFDC LinkedIn Portal. No offline mode is mentioned in the advertisement.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum qualification required for NFDC Waves Film Bazaar posts?
faq.answer: Most posts require a Graduate or Post Graduate degree in Mass Communication, Film Studies, Humanities, or a related discipline. Some posts such as Guest Relations and Hospitality & Logistics accept Graduates in any discipline.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for NFDC Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: The age limit varies from 35 years to 45 years depending on the post, with relaxation possible at NFDC's discretion for deserving candidates.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: The initial place of posting will be Mumbai as per the advertisement; however, selected candidates may be required to serve anywhere in India as per NFDC's requirement.

faq.question: Q8. What is the duration of the NFDC contract posts?
faq.answer: Contract durations vary by post, generally starting from 1st August 2026 or later, and ending on 30th November 2026 or 15th December 2026, depending on the specific role.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for NFDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official advertisement does not mention any application fee for these contractual posts.

faq.question: Q10. Who is the recruiting organisation for Waves Film Bazaar 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the National Film Development Corporation Ltd. (NFDC), a Government of India Enterprise, with contract hiring carried out through an outsourced agency selected by NFDC.
